scope: Read-only verification of original 8 accepted replay cohorts; no predictions rerun or modified; no new investment tests
limitations: Historical market/action observations reconstructed from current provider snapshot, not contemporaneous vendor archives
Sources and cutoff gates cannot erase model or human historical memory
Current surviving ETF/index sample cannot quantify full-universe survivor bias
Shared cross-market/date shocks and overlapping 12m/24m labels; 430 design rows or 374 mature labels are not independent N
Native indices are PRICE_ONLY and NONTRADABLE; pooled local-currency arithmetic label means are not portfolio CAGR
0% cash in original replay is unobserved assumption; separate USD BIL benchmark only for compatible markets/windows
Eight original SEC facts are data engineering evidence, not additional replay cases or support for investment principles
120 metadata-leak pilot rows retained and never Stage B evaluated; excluded from analysis
